metaSummary: This is a narrow meta that asks you to put yourself in a committed spot almost immediately. B Tier comps can be played if you have conditions for them, if not you are best off contesting a S or A tier comp. If you must play AD default some Aphelios variant if you can't reach level 9. The biggest development is 3 cost reroll being very prevalent.

comps.name: Azir Rammus Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: This comp requires lots of rods so take item augments early. Blackthorn sacrifice hex scales off gold value: 3* Teemo > 2* AP 4 cost that isn't holding items > 2* Teemo > 2* Veigar. Blackthorn Lux is a very strong win condition worth playing.

tips.tip: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with Blossom opener for better charms. Take rods off carousel whenever possible.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Rammus 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Once you finish, level for more Summoner / Executioner.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2
Level to 7 3-5 If you have an econ Augment
Level to 7 4-1 and hit your carry 2-star to stabilize.

comps.name: Lunar Kha'Zix Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: If you have HOJ first, go Executioner > Ravager. If you have AP / Mana / tempo slams, go Ravager > Executioner. Then pick Spellweaver > Rapidfire with the last evolutions. Can play 3rd Executioner/Lux/Ivern as max cap.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively on Kha'zix and move them later. It's okay to have Spark, Shojin, etc on Khazix early for takedowns.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, give leftover AP items to Diana.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2
Level to 7 3-5 If you have an econ Augment
Level to 7 4-1 and hit your carry 2-star to stabilize.

bm.name: Kha'Zix Reroll
conditions: High tempo and lots of items

plan.overview: Kha'Zix evolves with take downs meaning the earlier you get him, the faster you snowball. This also means slammable items are needed to accelerate the snowball. Playing Kha'Zix from behind is a recipe for disaster.
plan.stage2: Play around a stage 2 Kha'Zix with a slam. Be flexible as any leftover AP or melee carry item will go Diana late game.
plan.stage3: If you don't have a Kha'Zix at this point, it is impossible to play this line. Continue pushing tempo and making items for Kha'Zix and a front liner. Take an item augment if available on 3-2.
plan.stage4: Level to 7 on 4-1 and look to upgrade your board. Positioning is very important in this comp, specially in stage 4 where you can scam squishy 1 star back liners. Make sure to position like above to protect Kha'Zix. Mirror the positioning if the opponents are on the right side.
plan.stage5: Continue rolling for your 3 stars. After hitting, level for Aphelios at 8 and eventually Alune at 9.

tips: Kha'Zix Trait Priority: Ravager > Executioner > Spellweaver > Rapidfire
Ravager is first as it stabilizes the easiest, having some amount of healing on Kha'Zix
Kha'Zix can take any combination of Deathcap, Hand of Justice, Edge of Night and Striker's. Other items perform much worse.

Hecarim needs to be next to Kha'Zix as shown above to protect him from enemy carries. If other units are aggroed before Hecarim your Kha'Zix can get targeted prematurely. This positioning wants to be on the same side.
Diana items can be anything you made in the early game to save HP. Snowballing early is the top priority.
items: Kha'Zix : Deathcap, Hand of Justice, Edge of Night,

comps.name: Riftbeast Pebbles Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Use 5 Riftbeast shops to finish your 3* because you want to rush 7 Riftbeast on Level 7 ASAP. You can carry ALL of the riftbeast carries besides Mama Beak if you have items. Krug 3 is the best tank but you can also tank Sentinel 2 > Scuttle Crab 3. Alpha Mark Cinderling early > Crab late.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Pebbles items. Alpha Mark Crab or Gromp.
Save up econ and try to go level 7  for 7 riftbeast on 3-5, if you're poor wait until 4-1.
Once you have your 3*, level to 8 and field 7 Riftbeast. If you can get to 9, you can ditch 1* Ravagers for Elder Dragon.

levelingNotes: Do not press the level button at all until you 3 star your 1 cost.

bm.name: Riftbeast Reroll

plan.overview: Play around a strong Riftbeast opener and look to tempo into 7 Riftbeast. The good for this comp are very obvious (copies, a slam and access to 5 Riftbeast). If you do not have easy access to these conditions play something else.
plan.stage2: Play around Cinderling or Pebbles 2 with a slam. Look to hold every extra copy possible. Level for 5 Riftbeast by 2-5 if you have it. Having access to a Scuttle Crab makes stage 2 a lot easier to survive.
plan.stage3: 3-1 is the latest point to put in 5 Riftbeast as you are not allowed to roll for Pebbles or Cinderling and instead have to push levels. Getting to 7 Riftbeast is the highest priority.
plan.stage4: Level to 7 on 4-1 for 7 Riftbeast. Slowroll on this level and look for Krug 3 and any other 3 star Riftbeast you are able to itemize. The Riftbeast shops will give you Pebble 3 and Cinderling 3 eventually. Krug 3 is the key to allow 7 Riftbeast to scale. If you are way above tempo and are very healthy, consider sacking stage 4 and going level 9 to play around 7-10 Riftbeast around Elder Dragon.
plan.stage5: Level after finishing Krug 3 and look to add supporting traits to your board. 2 Brawler is the most likely to help as it allows you to scale into fights with a little more safety.

tips: Cinderling > Pebbles but both can do a tremendous amount of work. Cinderling only needs some AD caster items while Pebbles requires near bis.
Always Alpha Mark Scuttle Crab or Krug 3 as it allows you to stall for longer and scale up 7 Riftbeast.
Omega Riftbeast allows you to Alpha Mark Pebbles and Scuttle Crab allowing you to play for the Pebbles infinite without sacrificing front line.

comps.name: Elderwood Draven
comps.augmentsTip: Only play from early win streak and lots of gold. Because you are aiming for scaling 5 costs, aim to level 9 around end of Stage 4 / beginning of Stage 5. Best Draven quests are dealing damage for gold, but avoid the 10k damage in 1 round because you can get trapped.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Draven items. Ideal opener will be some kind of resource engine like Rengar or Blossom.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 end of Stage 4 and look for the scaling 5 costs like Draven, Maokai, and Ivern.

bm.name: Draven Fast 9
conditions: Lots of items or TGs to itemize 5 costs

plan.overview: This comp must go level 9 to be successful, if you find yourself rolling on 8 very much at all you likely already bot 4'd. Draven needs Guinsoo's, its the one needed item. If you can't reach 2 star 5 costs, you will die, making this a risky comp.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest opener around ideally a Guinsoo's slam. If you are loss streaking in stage 2, look for a different line to play.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong. If you get your win streak snapped or don't have enough money, look to pivot to something like Aphelios Flex .
plan.stage4: Most of the time you will sac stage 4 and look to level on 5-1/5-2. If you are dying consider leveling on 4-5 if you are rich.
plan.stage5: Level to 9 and roll for your board. Don't upgrade luxury legendaries you don't have items for until you have Draven 2 and Maokai 2 or Taric 2.

tips: Generally Pair Taric and Maokai, but if your backline is dying to AoE like Ahri or Morgana, consider pairing to Draven.
Itemized Kennen can be considered if you are losing the front to back and need to kill enemy backlines.
Draven is a traitless ramping carry, playing this unit without a Guinsoo's is a recipe for disaster.

Takedowns and Kills are 2 very different things for Draven's Bounty Seeker cash outs. Takedown means Draven participated in the kill while Kill means last hit. Make sure your Draven is strong enough to last hit consistently if you take a Kill quest as you might accidentally lock yourself out of Bounty Seeker Rewards.
Maokai scales with game length so the earlier you can roll down the better. Aim for 5-1 as a baseline, 5-2 at the latest.
Gnar and Kennen can hold almost any leftover AD or AP item respectively so don't be afraid to slam and build towards either of these units.
Ivern is a flex slot but an early Ivern can be a game winning.
Almost every item is usable in this line but prio Draven > Maokai > TGs.

comps.name: Invoker Ahri
comps.augmentsTip: Morgana holds utility items. You can tank either Sentinel or Sett. Best emblem = Invoker on Ahri. Late game cap with Ashe + Alune over Karma.

tips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

bm.name: Invoker Morgana and Ahri
conditions: Invoker Emblem Ahri bumps this up to S tier

plan.overview: This is a very item hungry comp that needs high quality items. Ahri and Morgana both have very strict item requirements. Ahri needs Jeweled Gauntlet and Morg needs both utility items. Frontline item quality is also important as Ahri and Morg need time to clear boards.
plan.stage2: Play around your strongest AP opener with a Jeweled Gauntlet slam. If you have Invoker Emblem already commit to this line. Item quality is very important in this line, if your items aren't looking like they can reach BIS, look towards a different line.
plan.stage3: Save HP as a you can on stage 3 and prepare to roll down on 4-2 for Ahri 2 and Morgana 2. A 3-2 item augment helps save HP and to meet the steep item requirements.
plan.stage4: Roll for Ahri 2, Morgana 2 and 1 of Sentinel 2 or Sett 2. Being strong on this stage is very important but should be easy if you have high item quality.
plan.stage5: Level to 9 for Taric, a Lux or more invoker levels after upgrading your board.

tips: Invoker Emblem is a great condition to force this comp.
Position Ahri on the same side as enemy carries to kill them before enemy front line dies.

Morgana needs Morello and Void Staff, they are very efficient on her and helps Ahri consistently kill back line in 2-3 casts. Her best 3rd item is Deathcap as it provides the most amount of flat stats.
items: Ahri : Invoker Emblem** , Jeweled Gauntlet , Striker's

comps.name: Nidalee Aphelios
comps.augmentsTip: Position Nidalee on weak side to get a quick kill then jump backline. Amumu or Sentinel 2 can be your main tank (you're often contested so prioritize whichever gets upgraded). Kogmaw Provides Free Shred + Sunder.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comps.name: Elderwood Ezreal Soraka
comps.augmentsTip: Mainly strong with Elderwood emblem. Look for Elderwood Lux. 3 Executioner is a big spike so always look to play around it if possible. Can also chase 9 Elderwood if you have Elderwood Lux.

tips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Soraka with 7 Elderwood. Try not to roll to 0g because we need gold to get to level 9.

bm.name: Elderwood Executioners
conditions: Elderwood and Executioner Emblems bumps this up a tier

plan.overview: This is a tempo comp for the most part and does not win out unless you are able to transition to full 5 cost or have multiple emblems. Most of the time unless you tempo into this comp you will be playing it with emblems or some sort of special condition.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest Elderwood opener making sure to hold Ornn as he is often played at level 8. If you are playing around emblems, make your strongest board and find a way to make it to stage 4 with decent HP. Consider Kha'Zix if you see him early.
plan.stage3: Keep up the tempo while slamming most items as this comp can use AD and AP items efficiently. Bleeding too much HP on this stage can kill odds at top 4 due to this comp not consistently capping the highest.
plan.stage4: If you are uncontested and healthy consider rolling on 4-5 instead of 4-2. The goal is to find a way to stabilize cheaply and go level 9 as Ezreal falls off later on in stage 5.
plan.stage5: Go 9 when possible and cap around Kennen and Gnar. Almost any 5 cost is playable on this board. Elderwood Lux is the best hit for this comp and can enable a win out.

tips: If you see Kha'Zix you can consider playing into that line instead as Kha'Zix 3 caps higher than Ezreal unless you reach 9.
Ezreal and Soraka both need a mana item to perform decently but outside of that the itemization is pretty flexible. Prioritize raw AD/AP if possible.
Emblems are what really open up this comp to be strong. Otherwise play it only from positions where you can use the Elderwood shell to go level 9.
Master of All Origins (Lux's Augment) can be good in this line as Elderwood Lux opens up 7/9 Elderwood which are incredibly strong on both stage 4 and 5.

comps.name: Defender Cassiopeia Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Very BIS dependent. Can play from Coven Cashout. Can also play for Ornn 3 to potentially farm Artifacts. Always play 6 Defender. Duo carry on 8 is any 4 or 5 cost AP carry. Titans on fiddle because we have no other use for bow.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Karma is an example shown but you can also play Invokers or Coven lose streak.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll on level 7 for Cassio 2 / Fiddle 2. Then econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3* units. Then level to 8 for a duo carry.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2
Level to 7 3-5 If you have an econ Augment
Level to 7 4-1 and hit your carry 2-star to stabilize.

bm.name: Cassiopeia Reroll
conditions: Artifacts and Emblems bump this up a tier

plan.overview: Play from a Cassio + Defenders opener. Very strong with special conditions such as Blighting Jewel and Consuming Flora or in cases you can cheat out an early Cassio 3. Play Vanguards if you have a Coven opener.
plan.stage2: Play around Defenders + Cassio or an AP item holder like Karma. BIS is very important so consider pivoting if reaching these items seems unrealistic. Play Coven if offered and look to cash out for Cassio and Elise copies.
plan.stage3: Look to stabilize on 3-5 if necessary around 6 Defender and Cassio 2. If you are playing Coven, look to cash out at 130 stacks and stabilize. Big cash outs are too greedy and miss this comps tempo window which is early stage 4.
plan.stage4: Slowroll for Cassio 3, Rammus 3 and Fiddlesticks 3. Take a 4-2 augment that either rushes a 3 star or provides you with enough items for 2 tanks. Continue clicking 40 cashes to farm copies if you are the Vanguard variant.
plan.stage5: Continue to roll if you haven't hit already. Level for 2 Flora Fatalis to supplement front line. Alune or a spellweaver go in at 8 for Vanguards.

tips: Place Fiddlesticks on the outside and Rammus directly next to him. Rammus' ability taunts enemies forcing them to attack him which means you can juggle enemy aggro this way and allow Fiddle to heal back up with his spell.
Cassio needs BIS. Her DPS is much lower without Deathcap or Archangel's, Gunblade is needed to provide enough stall. Blue Buff and Shojin are interchangeable but one of the 2 is required.

If you are playing this comp from Coven, play the vanguard variant. Cash out a 130 for a chance at Cassio 2 or some components. Continue to take every 40 cash from there for a chance at Cassio or Elise.
If you have a Defender Emblem consider playing a Rengar if you see him early enough. If not play Soraka over a 1 cost defender.
items: Blighting Jewel > Consuming Flora Emblem > Rdiant Blue > Dawncore
All of these replace a mana item.

comps.name: Elderwood Veigar Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Play with lots of copies of Ornn and Veigar, we need to hit fast to start scaling. Sacrifice Lifebloom plant to Blackthorn early. Late game you can sacrifice Leblanc 3 for big stats -> move her items to another spellweaver. After you hit rush 9 for Kobuko + Gnar. After you cash out first Ornn artifact, move items to Alistar.

tips.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar and Ornn 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish Ornn 3 and Veigar 3, you can slowroll on 6 for Leblanc + Alistar 3, if you are too far push levels..

levelingNotes: Do not press the level button at all until you 3 star your 1 cost.
On Stage 3-1, at level 4, you can roll to 32g (most common), slow roll, or roll until you hit 3*.
Be flexible in when you roll, be willing to break econ intervals if you are close or need tempo. Ideally finish 1 3 star by 3-5.
All in on 4-1 if you haven't hit already.

bm.name: Veigar Reroll

plan.overview: This comp is ideally played from a special condition such as Consuming Flora or an artifact or a lot of Veigar or Ornn copies with good slams. Veigar needs to get going early and start snowballing, if not you will not have enough AP to get through stage 4 and 5 front lines. This comp also needs a duo carry as Veigar is prone to getting stuck on front liners like Malphite.
plan.stage2: Play around your stronger opener with Veigar 2 and look to farm some AP on Veigar. Ideally we are playing from an Artifact or Consuming Flora + a slam so we should be 2 item Veigar on 2-1. A LeBlanc and Ornn opener can work as well to make progress towards an artifact.
plan.stage3: Roll on 3-1 for Veigar, Ornn, Karma and Rek'Sai copies. Stay above 40 gold. Slowroll from here on out unless you are 1 or 2 copies off, in which case consider digging. Buy a wisp every turn this stage. Feed Lifebloom not Karma at this point.
plan.stage4: If you finish your 1 cost 3 stars and don't have many LeBlanc copies consider pushing, if you are close consider staying at 6 as feeding LeBlanc 3 to Blackthorn can be a late game win condition.
plan.stage5: Level and add more Spellweavers. Duo carry Ahri or Alune and look to feed LeBlanc 3 for mana. Once you've farmed an artifact, move your items to Alistar 3.

tips: If you hit Veigar 3 way before anything else consider pushing levels to maintain tempo. You can use Malphite as a frontline alternative.
Blackthorn Feed Priority:
Leblanc 3> Karma 3 > Cassiopeia 2
Don't feed LeBlanc 3 if you are missing 3 stars and have items for her. Feed her when you have a good replacement like Ahri.

Alistar 3 is not required but very tanky. Move your items from Ornn after printing an artifact. You do not have to spend time rolling for him if you 3 star LeBlanc first as she will print him as you level.
The normal Flora Fatalis emblem is not good enough for this line. You need the special Consuming Flora emblem for Veigar to be strong enough.
items: Consuming Flora > Dawncore > Eternal Pact > Radiant Blue Buff

comps.name: Solar Karma Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Prioritize 3* Karma + 3 Blossom + LeBlanc early for clone copies. Add 3 Solar after you finish your 3* (Leona / Kayle not necessary).

tips.tip: Slam items for Karma and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Sejuani 2.
Try to look for an econ/exp wisp every round when rolling. Prioritize Karma 3 > Sejuani 3 > Yorick 3 > Leblanc / Yunara 3. Leona / Kayle not necessary.
Finish your 3* then level for 3 Solar over time. Leftover AP items on LeBlanc. Karma 3 can also hold items too.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2 and roll to stabilize. You just slowroll from here.

bm.name: Solar Yunara

plan.overview: This is a very expensive comp that requires both 5 3 stars and reaching level 8. It also has a very steep item requirement. There is a lot of rolling both at level 5 and 6, this requires a lot of patience to be rich enough to level to 8.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest opener around 3 Blossom or LeBlanc. Having one of these engines early provides much needed econ for this expensive comp. Unlike most 1/2c reroll comps, you can consider leveling on 2-1 if it makes you strong enough to win, specially with a LeBlanc opener. This comp can tempo around both AD and AP items.
plan.stage3: Play 3 Blossom + LeBlanc and Sejuani on level 5 to farm both upgraded wisps and LeBlanc copies. Roll on level 5 for Karma 3 and Yorick 3. Once you have 1 and 7/9 copies of the other look to level to 6 and add Azir for Executioner + Summoner.
plan.stage4: Level to 6 on 4-1/4-2 and continue rolling for your 3 star 2 costs. If you are close to spiking consider digging for 3 stars as being strong leads to more LeBlanc clone copies which can greatly accelerate you.
plan.stage5: Level to 7 and play 3 Solar over Azir. At level 8 add Azir. If you make it this far you are very likely top 2.

tips: You will be buying a wisp almost every turn with this comp. Blossom wisps are very strong and it's worth digging for quality wisps on most turns.

LeBlanc is a very important part to this comp as its half of the econ engine for an otherwise very expensive comp. Be as strong as you can on stage 3 and early 4 to print units with LeBlanc. If you fall behind on tempo, you fall behind on printing which leads to a reverse snowball.
LeBlanc 3 is great but Karma 3 is a suitable replacement. Chase Leona 3 if you do not think you will be able to 3 star LeBlanc.
Item augments are required for this comp as they are the easiest way to be strong on stage 3 and 4. If you reach 3 item Yunara and LeBlanc you will get kills which snowballs you as mentioned above.
With Prismatic Ticket you can consider playing for all 8 3 stars. Prioritize the ones highlighted above first.
items: LeBlanc : Shojin , Jeweled Gauntlet, Void Staff

comps.name: Dragon Draven
comps.augmentsTip: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Your duo carry with Elder Dragon is ideally Draven but its highly flexible. Can replace for Lux, Alune, Soraka for AP options.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

bm.name: Dragon Fast 9
conditions: Lots of items or TGs to itemize 5 costs

plan.overview: This comp is feast or famine. You must go level 9 to be successful, if you find yourself rolling on 8 very much at all you likely already bot 4'd. Elder 1 is weak and loses most fights but Elder 2 can be game winning so this comp can be risky if your spot can't consistently go level 9. Draven is the highest cap duo carry but not the only option.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest opener while slamming AD items for either Draven or Elder. Do not commit to this line if you are unsure in your ability to go 9.
plan.stage3: Continue your streak and look to pivot if you get snapped. Sivir, Nidalee and Aphelios hold most AD slams and are great pivot options.
plan.stage4: Most of the time you will sac stage 4 and look to level on 5-1/5-2. If you are dying consider leveling on 4-5 if you are rich.
plan.stage5: Level to 9 and roll for your board. Don't upgrade luxury legendaries you don't have items for until you have Dragon 2, Draven 2, and Maokai 2 or Taric 2.

tips: The frontline is flexible, the only static units are the 5 cost you are carrying which are close to traitless. Consider 2 Unit combos like Sett + Krug, Amumu or Maokai + Scuttle Crab and Sentinel + Taric instead of defaulting a certain front line.
Kog'Maw's Caustic trait provides Shred and Sunder so do not build these items if you intend on playing him.
Krug, Scuttle Crab and Sentinel can all be considered as the 3rd Riftbeast as they all provide great teamwide Alpha Mark buffs.
If you are playing Draven, you must have a Guinsoo's.
Maokai scales with game length so the earlier you can roll down the better. Aim for 5-1 as a baseline, 5-2 at the latest.

Takedowns and Kills are 2 very different things for Draven's Bounty Seeker cash outs. Takedown means Draven participated in the kill while Kill means last hit. Make sure your Draven is strong enough to last hit consistently if you take a Kill quest as you might accidentally lock yourself out of Bounty Seeker Rewards.
Elder's auto attacks cleave adjacent units dealing 75% of the original damage, make sure to position him between enemy front liners to get max value out of this.

This comp is even more feast or famine than Draven Fast 9 as we don't have a low cost shell to stabilize around. Draven Fast 9 can play to save HP around Elderwoods and can pivot in that direction if need be. This comp lives or dies by being able to find multiple 5 cost 2 stars. This means higher potential cap, more risk.
items: Elder Dragon : IE , Hand of Justice, Sterak's

comps.name: Elderwood Aphelios
comps.augmentsTip: Comp to play with AD items and an elderwood emblem. If you hit elderwood lux with emblem you can drop Lillia for 9 Elderwood.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll for Aphelios and Ezreal, you should be stable with 7 elderwood and one of these 2 starred. Go 9 when stable for Gnar+Lux.

comps.name: Spellweaver Ahri
comps.augmentsTip: Ahri 2 > Cassio 2 > Ahri 1 > Alune for backline item distribution, this comp doesn't have enough frontline for Alune's moon. Only play with spellweaver emblem, lategame move emblem + Cass items onto Lux or Ivern 2.

tips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

comps.name: Rapidfire Aphelios
comps.augmentsTip: Only strong with +1 Rapidfire, play another version if you have it. Don't need much attack speed with 5 rapidfire.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. All ad items are good slams besides rageblade.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comps.name: Camille Akali Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Akali can be AD or AP (Flex IE/JG) Itemize Tank + 3star melee first -> 2nd melee -> Varus items. Only go for Kayle and Sej 3 with lots of money. Can  Swap out Ornn for Yorick/Rakan.

tips.tip: Look to play with lots of early copies of 1 cost + good reroll augment.
Roll to 30 on 3-1 level 4 for extra 1 cost copies. Then slow roll on 5 until you have 5 3 stars for solar bonus.
Make sure you keep your econ high because you need to be level 7 to fit solar on this board. Try to be Level to 7 somewhere on stage 4.

levelingNotes: Do not press the level button at all until you 3 star your 1 cost.
On Stage 3-1, at level 4, you can roll to 32g (most common), slow roll, or roll until you hit 3*.
Be flexible in when you roll, be willing to break econ intervals if you are close or need tempo. Ideally finish 1 3 star by 3-5.
All in on 4-1 if you haven't hit already.

bm.name: Solar Akali Reroll
conditions: Goes up a tier with artifacts or reroll augments

plan.overview: Play this from a premium reroll augment, artifacts or a lot of copies Camille, Akali and Ornn. If you don't have one of these conditions make sure you are playing from a completely uncontested spot as missing is a death sentence in this comp.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest board around 2 Ravager with an Akali or Camille slam. Since Akali prefers to be AP and Camille is by default AD you should almost always have a slam for either one of them on 2-1. If you are playing this from loss streak you need a premium Reroll or econ augment.
plan.stage3: Roll down on 3-1 for upgrades, stop at 32 gold. If you get bench locked sell Leona copies first. Don't hold excess Kayles or Sejuanis on this roll down focus on the 1 cost. Econ back up and slow roll for your board.
plan.stage4: Roll down again on 4-1 if you need to 3 star units, continue slow rolling if your carries + Ornn are already 3 star.
plan.stage5: Tips:

tips: AP Akali recasts her spell on kill, setting her up to hit weak side of the enemy front line is key.
Printing an artifact from Ornn's Forge is very important to capping high with this comp. Ornn copies are as important as Akali and Camille copies.
Range extension is very strong on both Akali and Camille, consider RFC and Fishbones heavily.
Any augment that gives you free Rerolls is good for this line. Consider using free rolls aggressively on stage 2 to look for wisps such as Starting Town and cheat out upgrades.
Kayle 3 and Sejuani 3 are not neccessary and often too expensive.
If you have Inferno Emblem, careful when playing 3 Inferno as it can very often grief your first shop of the turn.
Lich Bane Akali is the best artifact for this comp and is close to auto win.
Hustler is very good for this comp. Roll on 2-1 and 2-2 to complete 1 cost pairs. Roll for a charm every turn on stages 2 and 3.
items: Akali : Edge of Night , Jeweled Lotus , Hand of Justice, Lich Bane*
Artifact priority: Lich Bane > RFC > Seeker's > Dawncore > Zhonyas
Fishbones > Mittens > Hellfire Hatchet > Titanic Hydra

comps.name: Alune AP Fast 9
comps.augmentsTip: Lunar Lux is best but play whatever Lux you are likely to 2* first. Carry / tank 4 cost units until you get to the end game. Always focus on unit quality over exact board units.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with AP items. Ideal opener will be Blossom featuring Karma / Spellweavers.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

comps.name: Summoner Malphite Flex
comps.augmentsTip: Core is Malphite + Azir + 2 Flora Fatalis for healing. Can play Ahri/Zyra/Ezreal as additional carries and Lillia/Amumu/Kennen/Maokai as supporting frontline.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Malphite items for a win streak.
Add in useful 3 costs like Fiddlesticks, Cassio, Azir then flex around their traits. General rule: put items on upgraded units.
Level and roll for Malphite. You will often have to itemize and work with whoever you hit so don't overly tunnel on your roll down.

bm.name: Flora Malphite

plan.overview: The goal of this comp is to keep Malphite alive as long as possible for Soraka and Zyra to scale into the fight. Flora Fatalis synergizes great with a solo front line unit as he is always likely to be the lowest % HP ally. The board is flexible and the only required units are Soraka, Zyra, Malphite, Azir and Fiddle.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest AP opener, ideally around Karma and Blossom to farm empowered wisps, but anything will do. If you are loss streaking prioritize rods on carousel.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong if possible while collecting Malphite, Soraka and Zyra items. Do not slam too aggressively, item quality in this comp is very important. Malphite needs pure tank items while Soraka and Zyra each want a mana item.
plan.stage4: Roll aggressively for Malphite 2 on 4-2 as he will likely be contested. As stated above this comp only requires 5 core units so the 3 slots on level 8 are very flexible.
plan.stage5: Go 9 and look for 5 cost. This comp can easily play almost any 5 cost but prioritize Kennen and 3 Executioner.

tips: Flora Fatalis is a front line trait for Malphite and is absolutely essential, this comp does not function the same without it.
Sacrifice a 3 cost, usually Fiddlesticks, to give your Malphite maximum stats.
There are multiple variants of this comp but Soraka, Zyra, Malphite, Azir and Fiddle are constants. 5 cost and emblems usually dictate what variations to go towards.
Soraka launches more stars at her target if she has already casted on them previously so position her to hit main tanks.
There are many great emblems for this comp. Consider augments like Trait Tree and Spreading Roots heavily for this line.
If intend on playing Inferno, don't prioritize making anti-heal.
Emblems augments are great in this comp as it has a lot of hanging traits and can flex a lot of different traits.
items: Zyra : Jeweled Gauntlet, Void Staff, Shojin

comps.name: Juggernaut Zyra
comps.augmentsTip: Turtle Primal buff. Composition is flexible as long as you get to the upgraded Juggernaut frontline. Best with Juggernaut emblem on Kennen. Prio Zyra Items > secondary carries. Sivir + Ashe is strong, but AP Nidalee or 5 costs like Ivern/Lux/Draven are also good.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Tank items for a win streak.
Ideally start holding more juggernauts to pair with the Yorick blossom opener, consider moving karma items to LB or Cassio 2.
Level and roll for 6 Juggernauts + Zyra and a duo-carry. You can push 9 when you hit Zyra 2. Tank Vi 2 over Amumu 1. End game move items to Maokai.

comps.name: Eclipse Kayle Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Roll on level 5 for 3* 1 costs, then level up to roll on 6 for 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*. When in doubt, add more tank and stall for Eclipse to kill units.

tips.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded frontline. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items. Econ up as much as possible. Don't spend gold on leveling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Sejuani 3 > Leona 3 > Shen 3 / Varus 3. Once you finish Kayle 3, begin pushing levels for Lunar units.
Finish your 3* and level for Lunar units to get Eclipse in. Lunar Lux or Solar Lux are both good.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2 and roll to stabilize. You just slowroll from here.

comps.name: Master Yi Rengar Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: +1 tier in strength with Artifact.  VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3. Item priority: Master Yi/Rengar > Tank > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. Otherwise, Execute / Healing Primal. Rengar and Yi have the exact same BIS. Yi is stronger but itemize whoever is upgraded first.

tips.tip: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi/Rengar items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Rengar 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Kog or a flex unit in at 8.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2
Level to 7 3-5 If you have an econ Augment
Level to 7 4-1 and hit your carry 2-star to stabilize.

comps.name: Riftbeast Elder Dragon
comps.augmentsTip: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Strong with any augment that gives you +1 team size so you can fit in another carry.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

comps.name: Blackthorn Ravager Warwick Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Aim to play a 3* unit in the Blackthorn center hex for max stats, preferably Krug 3. Leftover AD items on Murkwolf. Can also tank Rek'sai 3 if you can't find Malphite 2.

tips.tip: If you don't have Shojin, consider lose streak to guarantee it on carousel. If you have Shojin + good component, play for win streak instead.
Level to 6 and roll for Warwick 2 with 4 Blackthorn + 2 Ravager. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. You can also play 4 Ravager temporarily if needed.
Finish Warwick 3 and push levels. If you don't have Murkwolf 3, look for Brambleback as your duo carry.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2 and roll to stabilize. You just slowroll from here.

comps.name: Elderwood Blossom
comps.augmentsTip: Best with Executioner emblem. Focus Ezreal + Tank items first then rest on Ahri->Soraka. Elderwood Lux caps the board.

tips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Ezreal and the 4 costs, only go 9 once you have upgraded most things.

comps.name: Azir Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: More of an Azir comp than a Khazix comp, we just want executioner buff than we feed Kha to blackthorn hex for offensive Azir Stacks. If you have lots of Kha upgrades drop Sett + Reksai for Ahri + WW/Malphite for Spellweaver+Ravager. With enough mana gen from blackthorn, Azir doesn't need attack speed, but Rageblade is okay on him.

tips.tip: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with blossom opener for better charms.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Kha and Vi on 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Make sure Kha has 8 takedowns before feeding to blackthorn, 3 executioner is very important.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2
Level to 7 3-5 If you have an econ Augment
Level to 7 4-1 and hit your carry 2-star to stabilize.

bm.name: Azir Rammus Reroll

plan.overview: This comp needs at least 3 rods. Azir needs Gunblade and at least 1 other rod item and Rammus really wants Crownguard due to his shield's high AP ratio. Teemo 3 is premium to feed to Blackthorn but Soraka 2 works if you miss.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest opener around a Rod slam. Azir's itemization is relatively flexible as long as it provides HP. Saving HP is key to allow enough time to hit 3 star 3 costs later on.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong if possible. If you are loss streaking consider leveling on 3-5 and rolling for a board.
plan.stage4: Roll on 4-1 for Azir 2, Rammus 2 and the rest of the board. Slow roll after hitting 2 stars and key synergies. If you miss on Soraka, play any Executioner.
plan.stage5: Level for Executioner trait levels after hitting Azir 3 and Rammus 3.

tips: Rammus' shield has a massive AP ratio making Crownguard a very good item on him.
This comp requires a lot of Rods as Azir needs Gunblade and sources of AP, ideally Rabadons. Guinsoo's is not needed, but is quite decent.
Feed Priority: Teemo 3 > Soraka 2 > Teemo 2.
Itemize Zyra over Soraka in most cases as a secondary carry.

comps.name: Blackthorn Malphite
comps.augmentsTip: Sacrifice a high quality unit like 2* 4 cost Soraka so you can get lots of Mana + Damage Amp for your Blackthorn carries. Blackthorn Lux caps the board very high, but you can also play Alune instead.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Malphite items for a win streak.
Add in useful 3 costs like Fiddlesticks, Cassio, Azir then flex around their traits. General rule: put items on upgraded units.
Level and roll for Malphite. You will often have to itemize and work with whoever you hit so be flexible. Once stable on Azir 2, Zyra, and Malphite, push to 9.

comps.name: Vanguard Aphelios
comps.augmentsTip: Core units are Aphelios + Diana + Sentinel + Mama Beak. Red Buff is BIS Aphelios but you can also play Rageblade build. Play Scuttlecrab + Rakan over Brambleback if no melee items. Can duo carry Zyra or Morgana if extra AP items.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comps.name: Aphelios Flex
comps.augmentsTip: Core units are Aphelios + Diana + Sentinel + Mama Beak. This is a variation of Aphelios to play with AP items instead of melee items. Red Buff is BIS Aphelios but you can also play Rageblade build. Frontline is either Amumu+Scuttlecrab or Sett + Krug.

tips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

bm.name: Aphelios Flex

plan.overview: Aphelios is the gameplan when you have a good AD opener but can't quite bridge the gap to level 9 and play for Draven. He is a great AD default and uses most items decently. Nidalee is the best duo carry but Brambleback can work, specially if you have a Rapidfire Emblem.
plan.stage2: Play a strong opener around any AD or Attack Speed slam. Guinsoo's isn't BIS but it is strong early game and more than serviceable.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong around an AD holder with Aphelios or Nidalee items. If you are heavily loss streaking prepare to roll down on 4-1 to try to hit Sentinel and Nidalee before the rest of the lobby.
plan.stage4: Roll down for Aphelios, Sentinel and Nidalee. Flex the front line if the lobby is heavily contesting Sentinel. Nidalee can stabilize bad spots extremely well so prioritize her itemization if you are playing from low HP.
plan.stage5: Don't level to 9 until you've 2 starred Aphelios and Brambleback. Go 9 for Alune or a Lux.

tips: If you fully miss on Sentinel, Amumu + Juggernauts can hold the front line down. The goal is to have enough stall to protect Nidalee as she resets.
Guinsoo's on Aphelios is not BIS, Red Buff is. However, Guinsoo's is more than acceptable and should be slammed for tempo in stage 2. His itemization is very flexible as long as he has
The Nidalee variant has the added advantage of not needing sunder due to Kog'Maw's passive.
Nidalee has a lot of scam potential if you position her towards the enemy weakside. If you can get both Aphelios and Nidalee on a weak front liner on stage 4 you can win fights for free.
Nidalee and Brambleback are both very dependent on their core items. Nidalee needs Shojin while Brambleback needs at least 2 defensive items.
If you have Rapidfire Emblem play 5 Rapidfire instead with the emblem on Brambleback. Position on weakside to get as many resets on Brambleback as possible.
Amumu takes pure tank items, Sentinel likes mana tank items like Vow.
items: Guinsoo's, Deathblade, Last Whisper, Giant Slayer
Brambleback : Sterak's, Edge of Night, QSS

comps.name: Primal Nidalee Sivir
comps.augmentsTip: Krug on the Blackthorn hex. Prioritize Nidalee > Sivir items. Kogmaw provides free Shred and Sunder. Max cap is drop riftbeasts for Gnar + Ashe + Taric. Hunter emblem is incredible on Nidalee. Can also drop Malphite for Sett + Vanguard. Take tiger primal buff.

tips.tip: Play around a strong AD opener around Cinderling 2 with Riftbeasts. Slam all your AD and tank items aggressively for win streak.
Comp is very Sword hungry so keep taking them off augments / carousels when possible. You can flex in 5 Riftbeast for better shops or more generic frontline.
Level to 8 and roll for Nidalee, Sivir, and Malphite / tank. If Malphite is too contested, consider Sentinel or Krug tank instead.

bm.name: Primal Malphite
conditions: High quality tank items for Malphite

plan.overview: This comp is an expensive level 8 comp that contests Malphite and Sentinel, which are very popular at the moment. Look to be rich on 4-2 and find these units before other players. This comp is often ok with being stuck on 8 and buying wisps every turn due to the high cost of 2 starring this board. This comp needs a lot of swords.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest AD opener preferably around an IE slam. If you don't have a great opener look to loss streak and collect swords on carousel for BIS.
plan.stage3: Look to continue collecting items for Nidalee and Sivir. If you highrolled 2 Primal consider the item buff as you will likely be able to farm all 4 components.
plan.stage4: Roll down aggressively on 4-2 to find Malphite and Sentinel before other players. Stage 4 is this comps tempo window so look to be as strong as possible.
plan.stage5: Don't level until you've 2 starred Nidalee, Sivir and Malphite unless you are very healthy and waiting for contestors to die. Go level 9 for Ashe or Taric when possible.

tips: Take the Execution Primal buff most of your games. If you are >50 HP and strong you can consider taking items.
Primal Buff Prio: Execute > Healing > Attack Speed
Kog'Maw's Caustic trait provides Shred and Sunder so don't build it when playing this comp.
Beast's Within allows you to take execute and items (the best 2 primal buffs for this comp) without having access to 4 Primal.
Jeweled Lotus allows us to skip building IE on both Sivir and Nidalee and is a great augment for this comp.
Itemization is flexible as long as it provides AD after IE is built. Prioritize at least 1 defensive item for Nidalee.
Shojin Nidalee is very good as she deals bonus damage and heals herself every 3rd cast.

Nidalee has a passive that allows her to target the lowest item count unit in a 3 hex range after getting a kill. This means position her weak side so she can potentially jump to unitemized back liners.
Sacrifice a 3 cost, usually Krug, to give your Malphite maximum stats. The Krug alpha mark effect does not proc when it is sacrificed to Blackthorn so do not alpha mark him ever.
items: Nidalee : IE , Shojin , Hand of Justice
Deathblade, Giant Slayer, Shojin, Blue Buff
Sentinel : Leftover Tank, Vow, Adaptive Helm

comps.name: Invoker Morgana
comps.augmentsTip: Can play from Coven Cashout. Aim for 250 + essence for chance at Morgana 2 + item cashout. Void staff still okay with Kog since he doesn't hit backline.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Teemo is an example shown but you can also play Pebbles, Spellweavers, or Coven.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll down on level 8 for Morgana 2, Sentinel, and 4 Invoker. If you don't have Bramble items, flex in another AP carry like Ahri / Nidalee.

comps.name: Juggernaut Caitlyn Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Can also tank Sejuani 3. Tank whoever you can hit first. Can also play 4 Vanguard version with Elise. Sivir takes leftover utility / AD items (red buff highly impractical so oftentimes you play Morello). Take Turtle Primal buff. +1 or 2 tiers with radiant items (especially radiant Guinsoo).

tips.tip: Slam Rageblade and bow items on Caitlyn for a winstreak. BIS Caitlyn is often hard to get so you can also slam items like Gunblade or Giant Slayer.
Level to 6 and roll for 4 Juggernaut + 2 Hunter. Ideally upgrade Caitlyn 2 and 2 cost Juggernaut then econ up -> slow roll above 50g for 3* units.
Finish your 3* ideally by mid Stage 4. Level for more Hunters. Take Turtle Primal unless you are super high rolling and can take items.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2 and roll to stabilize. You just slowroll from here.

bm.name: Caitlyn Reroll

plan.overview: Standard 2 cost reroll around Caitlyn. Caitlyn scales the best off attack speed so this comp requires multiple bows. Scuttle Crab 3 or Sejuani 3 can be main tanked.
plan.stage2: Play around a Caitlyn orb with Guinsoo's or Kraken. If you find yourself with these slams but no Caitlyn's you can consider pivoting in at 3-2. If you have Coven you can play it for a few turns but this comp does not want to play Coven deep into stage 3.
plan.stage3: Roll on 3-2 to stabilize around Caitlyn 2, 2 Hunter and 4 Juggernauts. If you have been playing Coven, look to pivot out by 3-5, don't greed a huge cash out in this comp and instead aim to be strong on stage 3.
plan.stage4: Continue rolling for Caitlyn 3, Scuttle 3 and Sej 3. Look to level for more Hunters or Juggernauts after you hit 3 stars.
plan.stage5: Go 9 for Ashe. If you reach Ashe with a Shojin, you have great top 2 potential.

tips: Hunters get 10% damage amp for hitting the same target for 4 seconds or longer so prioritize targeting the main tank down first to get full effectiveness from this passive.
Caitlyn is a specialist and does not cast a spell making any mana item on her completely useless.
Elise and Vanguards might give access to Coven cash outs but are substantially weaker than 3 star Juggernauts.

comps.name: Juggernaut Ashe
comps.augmentsTip: Consider this as a flex option for a Sivir board if you were playing around Juggernauts in the midgame already. If you get Juggernaut emblem, you can play 6 Juggernauts. Can also play other 5 cost AD carries like Dragon and Draven. Take turtle primal buff.

tips.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak.
Level up for more juggernauts and executioners to pair with our blossom opener.
Level and roll for 6 juggernauts +Sivir. Once stable, go 9 and look for Ashe and transition your board to 5 costs.

bm.name: Juggernaut Flex

plan.overview: This is a tempo comp best played from a strong Juggernaut opener. The back line can be virtually anything but Ashe, Zyra and Sivir all deal good sustained damage and work well together. Your items will decide what back line you primarily play around. Look to take item and combat augments to leverage the strength of this cheap, but strong front line.
plan.stage2: Play around early Juggernauts + any back line that fits easily. Whatever you slam will decide what unit you prioritize on level 8. AP means Zyra or Alune, AD means Sivir which eventually leads to Ashe.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong around Juggernauts and a back line. A 3-2 item or combat augment can help continue a streak.
plan.stage4: Roll down for you desired 4 cost back liner if you are bleeding HP. If you are healthy and have a back line that gets a few kills each fight, consider going fast 9 for Ashe or Alune.
plan.stage5: Level to 9 as soon as possible and look for a 5 cost to cap around. The earlier you field Maokai the easier it will be to win out due to his scaling HP.

tips: This comp is a tempo comp through and through. Unless you have access to a broken combat augment you are not likely to win out unless you reach level 9.
Alune is the highest AP cap and Ashe is the AD alternative.
Scuttle is a core early game hold as it enables 3 Riftbeast.
Zyra does great with scaling items in this set up, prioritize Archangel's.
This comp can use a lot of items, be willing to slam aggressively as tempo is key to success with this comp.
items: Ashe : Red Buff, Last Whisper , Shojin
Sivir : Infinity Edge, Shojin/Blue Buff, Striker's

comps.name: Elderwood Teemo Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Best with winstreak opener around Leblanc or Teemo with Brawler frontline.

tips.tip: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP. The more Teemo casts, the more likely you can collect value off his mushrooms.
Level to 6 and roll for your 2* upgrades to stabilize and win streak Stage 3. Econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Finish Teemo 3* and your tank then push levels for more Invokers. If you get more damage items late game Morgana can hold the utility.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2 and roll to stabilize. You just slowroll from here.

comps.name: Invoker Nidalee
comps.augmentsTip: Prioritize Nidalee > Morello on Morgana + Tank > leftover AP on Morgana. Riftbeast Alpha Mark the Scuttle Crab. Kogmaw provides free Sunder / Shred. Take tiger primal buff.

tips.tip: Play any strong Rageblade opener on an AP carry such as Kayle, Master Yi, or a Spellweaver. Opener is very flexible.
Comp is very Rod hungry so keep taking them off augments / carousels when possible. If you are not playing Invokers, hold onto cheap units like Pebbles for later.
Level to 8 and roll for 4 Invoker. Avoid tunneling only on 4 Vanguard frontline. You can also flex Brawlers or Juggernauts as needed.

bm.name: Invoker Nidalee
conditions: Be willing to flex the front line

plan.overview: This comp is very item hungry and contests Sentinel and Morgana which are very popular right now. You need at least 1 econ augment and 1 item augment to meet these condition reliably. Be flexible on 4-2 as you will not always hit Sentinel.
plan.stage2: This comp is ideally played from an AP item slam such as Jeweled Gauntlet, Morello or Guinsoo's. Almost any opener that can hold these items will do as the only relevant low cost unit is Rakan.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong by slamming items. If you to clicked econ 2-1, look to click items 3-2 and vice versa.
plan.stage4: Level on 4-2 and look for Morgana, Nidalee and Sentinel + a supporting board. Be flexible and don't fully commit to 4 Vanguards unless you hit Sentinel 2 or Taric. Consider Amumu which ties in with Rakan and removing 2 Sentinels for Sett + Krug/Gnar.
plan.stage5: Go 9 and look for Alune and Taric to cap out. Replace low quality items with heavier AP ones as you get them on Morgana.

tips: Take the Execution Primal buff most of your games. If you are >50 HP you can consider taking items.

Nidalee's itemization is more specific than Morgana's, however it does not make Morgana's item quality any less important. Nidalee needs Guinsoo's and ideally Jeweled Gauntlet to shine. Morgana requires Morello. This means this comp needs 3 rods at a minimum but the more the better.
Flex the front line, the only static units are Nidalee, Vi, Morgana, Kog'Maw, Sentinel +1 Vanguard. The rest can be whatever you 2 star on your roll down.
Kog'Maw's Caustic trait provides Shred and Sunder but it is OK to build it Void Staff on Morgana as she hits more of the board.
Beast's Within allows you to take execute and items (the best 2 primal buffs for this comp) without having access to 4 Primal and bumps this comp up a tier.

comps.name: Vanguard Rengar Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Strong with artifacts. Rengar prefers to be paired with other carries that can use AD scaling. But he is a flexible unit with no traits so you can play him with whatever you hit.

tips.tip: Only play this comp with an early Rengar with items so you can snowball Rival. Play any upgraded frontline tank to stall for Kha'zix.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, if you can't hit Mama Beak 3, look for Aphelios duo instead.

comps.name: Solar Kayle Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Roll on 3-1 to try and finish a 3* 1 cost for bench space -> Slow roll above 50g on level 5. Ornn Artifact print is very strong but only scales quickly once you get him to 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*.

tips.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded Ornn. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items on Ornn so he can begin reliably stacking Artifact scaling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Ornn 3 > Xayah / Leona > Sejuani > Rakan. Once you finish 1 costs, move up to level 6 for 2 costs.
Finish your 3* and level for Elderwood. Cap with any 5 costs like Lux, Ivern, Taric, etc.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)

bm.name: Kayle Reroll

plan.overview: This comp must 3 star 5 total units to come online. Kayle caps incredibly high if you are able to 3 star her along with 4 other units. Having items in the early mid game is incredibly important to stack up Ornn's Forge and save HP, so we prioritize item augments.
plan.stage2: Ideally play this comp from a lot of econ or a strong opener around Kayle or Xayah. If you are able to save HP in stage 2 you get a lot of room to make up for any lowrolls on stage 3 and 4. Scout and make sure you are not contested, if you are look to pivot.
plan.stage3: If you are missing 1 cost upgrades, dig on level 4 on 3-1 to finish any pairs. Otherwise play slow and roll on 3-2 at level 5 for good odds at both 1 cost and 2 costs.
plan.stage4: Continue rolling for your 3 stars. Once you have Ornn, Xayah and 1 of Rakan or Leona, look to level to 6 and roll there for better 2 cost odds.
plan.stage5: Level for Hecarim and more Rapidfire trait levels. If you make it to 9 drop Hecarim for 3 Lunar to activate Eclipse. If you made it this far, you likely are top 2.

tips: If you have Cursed Crown you can reroll for 8 3 stars much more comfortably as you can field everything you need at level 6. This can be absolutely game winning if you get there and being up 2 unit slots provides enough tempo to do this consistently.
If you get bench locked always sell first Sejuani, followed by Rakan. Never sell Kayle, Ornn or Xayah.
Be patient playing this comp, if you hit all 5 3 stars you will be strong. Don't panic and rolldown too early and limit your scaling.
If you have an extra Vow or tear tank item, Rakan is a great holder as his cast gives your Kayle attack speed.

Roll aggressively for high value wisps when playing this comp. You can accelerate your game greatly by being picky with your wisps and potentially high rolling wisps such as Starting Town and Field of Mice.

comps.name: Ashe Dragon Fast 9
comps.augmentsTip: Prioritize Ashe items > Tank items > leftover duo carry items (ideally Elder Dragon). Comp is very expensive so make sure you take good econ augments.

tips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play around 3 Blossom for a win streak. This is a comp you can only play from far ahead with lots of HP and resources.
Continue your win streak. Pick an econ augment if you have not already. Otherwise, take item augments and push levels.
If you have 80+ HP, you can consider losing Stage 4 and focus purely on economy. Aim to Fast 9 by end of Stage 4 / 5-1 and transition your board.

bm.name: Ashe Fast 9
conditions: Lots of items or TGs to itemize 5 costs

plan.overview: This is the easiest variant of Fast 9 to pivot into as it can play from an Invoker Morg + Ahri set up, anormal Blossom set up or a Sivir set up. There are a lot of boards that can lead into this comp as the only hard requirement is a Shojin on Ashe and the ability to go level 9.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest opener around Blossom ideally to farm upgraded wisps. If you are not win streaking look to pivot to a level 8 Ahri variant.
plan.stage3: Continue your win streak and ideally take an item augment on 3-2 to remain strong and help meet the hefty item requirements of this comp.
plan.stage4: If you reach stage 4 with 80+ HP, look to take an econ augment on 4-2 and sac the stage. Aim to go 9 on 5-1.
plan.stage5: Transition your board to the one above and roll for a wisp every turn. Level 10 is often a bait if you have not 2 starred your entire board or are insanely rich.

tips: Take the Healing primal buff almost always. If you pivoted in from a Sivir set up items or execute can be ok as well.
This comp can be pivoted into from most Ahri or Sivir variants. Ashe can be used to cap out both of those comps.
Taric and Gnar are replaceable with one another. If you are main tanking Sett, play 2 Brawler.
Maokai can take a while to scale, do not itemize Maokai 1.

Ashe's spell covers a lot of the board and ticks enemies down over time, this makes Last Whisper and Red Buff very efficient on her. Her spell can be thought of like Morgana's where utility is BIS due to all the uptime.
Ashe wants to be opposite side of enemy as she shoots her arrow towards the largest line of enemies.
7 Blossom during stage 4 can be a great condition to play this comp from as you will be rich enough to get to max cap.
6 Juggernaut is a way to get to 9 and cap out. If you are very rich you can drop to 4 Juggernauts + Legendaries.
items: Ashe : Shojin/Blue, Red Buff , Last Whisper

comps.name: Adaptor Kog'Maw
comps.augmentsTip: +1 tier in strength with Artifact or Brawler emblem. Level 7 board is no Gromp. VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3, but harder to hit because of Vi's popularity. Item priority: Master Yi > Tank > Kogmaw > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. Otherwise, Execute / Healing Primal.

tips.tip: Ideally play around a Master Yi opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Kogmaw 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Gromp or a flex unit in at 8.

bm.name: Adaptor Reroll
conditions: Artifacts Bump this up a tier
Ability to 3 star Yi and a front liner

plan.overview: Play around a Yi, Rengar orb or a 2-1 artifact to get into this line. Master Yi is a stat stick that needs to either hit before tempo or have a special item to perform. Rengar is a great duo carry that can accelerate your econ but is very item specific and inconsistent to play for from behind. Non-Rengar Yi is AP, Yi Rengar is AD.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest board around an early Yi or Rengar and 3 Blossom or an Artifact holder. Do not hard commit to this line unless you have an Artifact, uncontested Rengar line or Bruiser Emblem.
plan.stage3: If by 3-2 the Yi set up looks inconsistent look to pivot to a 4 cost line. If you have a strong stage 3 Yi or Rengar set up use the tempo to econ up to roll for Yi 3 on stage 4.
plan.stage4: Slow roll for Yi, Kog'Maw, Rengar and a 3 star front liner. If you don't have a special item you will likely struggle against upgraded 4 cost boards unless you can cheat out a 3 star ahead of tempo.
plan.stage5: Complete your 3 stars and push for more Adaptor trait levels. If you reach 3 item Yi, Kog'Maw, Tank and Rengar you are in a great spot to top 2.

tips: Nidalee 2 is a enough to cover backline damage if you miss on Kog'Maw 3 but Yi 3 is absolutely non-negotiable.
This comp doesn't do great from behind so make sure you have a very good condition if you are playing it from loss streak.
Take the Healing Primal buff most of your games. If you are >50 HP, strong and have a consistent way for Nidalee to get takedowns, you can consider taking items.
Primal Buff Prio: Healing > Attack Speed > Execute
If you have a Yi already and see Cooking Pot use it to make Brawler Emblem and feed your Yi HP till 3-5 where you will likely spike.

Rengar is the best duo carry for Yi and his items should be prioritized, however they are not very flexible. Guinsoo's is required and so is Edge of Night. Only consider Rengar if you have him early enough or have the item economy to support him even.
Rengar can go in over Nidalee if you are not farming items from Primal or need the combat buff. If not consider dropping Krug.
AD Yi wants QSS as Guinsoo's provides AP which can force him into the incorrect Adaptor form.
AP Yi wants Guinsoo's as its the best scaling attack speed source available and the AP ensures he's in the correct Adaptor form
items: AP Master Yi : Guinsoo's , Edge of Night , Titan's
Special Item Priority: Wit's End > Hellfire Hatchet > Flickerblade > Fishbones > RFC > Brawler Emblem > Titanic
Everything replaces Titan's except for Flicker which replaces Guinsoo's
AD Master Yi : QSS , Edge of Night , Titan's
Special Item Priority: Hellfire Hatchet > Fishbones > RFC > Brawler Emblem > Titanic
Rengar: Guinsoo's , Edge of Night , Titan's
Nidalee : Guinsoo's, Leftover AP or AD

comps.name: Sprykin Teemo Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Best with Sprykin emblem and lots of copies of Teemo early. Sacrifice a 3* unit (ideally Kobuko) to give Rek'Sai big stats. Can also tank Rammus 3 if very rich / high rolling. Kog'maw provides free Shred / Sunder.

tips.tip: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP. The more Teemo casts, the more likely you can collect value off his mushrooms.
Level to 6 and roll for your 2* upgrades to stabilize and win streak Stage 3. Econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Finish Teemo 3* and your tank then push levels for more Sprykins. Cap the board with Gnar or another 5 cost.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)

comps.name: Sivir Flex
comps.augmentsTip: Just a small variation on the malphite board, play Amumu + Vanguard over Blackthorn/Brawler. Prioritize Nidalee > Sivir items. Kogmaw provides free Shred and Sunder. Max cap is drop riftbeasts for Maokai + Ashe + Kennen. Hunter emblem is incredible on Nidalee. Take tiger primal buff.

tips.tip: Play around a strong AD opener around Cinderling 2 with Riftbeasts. Slam all your AD and tank items aggressively for win streak.
Comp is very Sword hungry so keep taking them off augments / carousels when possible. You can flex in 5 Riftbeast for better shops or more generic frontline.
Level to 8 and roll for Nidalee, Sivir, and Amumu/Sentinel. Buy Hecarim on Rolldown as well if you miss taric and itemize him over 1 star 4 costs.

comps.name: Dark Ritual Elise Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Play with Dark Ritual augment to convert cash out -> AP. Ideally ply for a 250+ cashout for AP first, then take 40s if you need for more stacking. 2x Morgana 2* with items on both is the best way to cap your board.

tips.tip: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence. It is actually better to win early than lose for stacks so don't overly force lose streak.
Level to 6 and roll for a Elise 2, Covens, and Vanguards. Give Cassio or Diana leftover AP. Cash out Coven and convert to AP with at least 2-3 lives (25-30 hp).
Finish Elise 3 / Cassio 3 then level for more Vanguards or Lunar. Play 2 Morganas with items if you have extra.

levelingNotes: Level to 4 on 2-1 if you are strong/have a copy of the unit you are rerolling + a slammable item
Level to 5 on 2-5 if you are strong, if not make econ (20)
Level to 6 on 3-2 and roll to stabilize. You just slowroll from here.

comps.name: Bronze For Life Ahri
comps.augmentsTip: Play when you hit Zyra 2 on your Ahri rolldown instead of Morgana. Play 5 blossom on level 8 with Karma+1 then try to go 9 for the 5 costs, itemize alune 2 lategame.

tips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Spellweavers + frontline as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Zyra, and the 4 Spellweavers. Play Cassio or LeBlanc until you find Alune.

comps.name: Inferno Lux Ashe
comps.augmentsTip: Only play with Inferno emblem. Ideally needs Inferno Lux to be super strong but can top 4 without Lux / only Inferno Emblem Ashe. Can also play more frontline instead of 7 inferno or Hunter (Taric/4 Juggernaut).

tips.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak. You can also play around Varus/Akali 2 with AD items.
Level and add more Juggernauts and Executioners. Make sure to hold Inferno units along the way. Can also play 3 Inferno for shop high rolls.
Roll on 8 for 5 inferno Sivir + Vi + Lillia + Hunter (can play Tristana before Ashe). When you find Ashe make sure to give her inferno emblem + shojin.

comps.name: Trait Ladder
comps.augmentsTip: Hard flex composition, but very strong when played well. Any emblem start is fine. Get Khazix 10 takedowns for ravager evolution while gathering the early 2-8 trait cashouts in the midgame. The key interval to plan for is 10 traits for the Tactician Crown -> pivot to legendaries or go for even more cashouts if healthy.

tips.tip: Ideally start with Khazix to get 10 takedowns ASAP. Add in the cheap 1-2 cost units to activate traits. Otherwise, flex around your best upgraded unit.
Continue adding and flexing in more traits. +1 team size augments like Coronation or Cursed Crown are very OP here.
After you hit 11 traits, add Amumu with the Tactician's Crown you get and then level for Kennen. Then pivot to 5 costs at level 9.

comps.name: Solar Aphelios
comps.augmentsTip: Frontline is very flexible: Lillia + Amumu + Sentinel are your flex options. Best with Lunar emblem so you can avoid the Alune lottery. When in doubt, add frontline to stall for Eclipse. Lux caps the board.

tips.tip: Play any tempo opener that can lead to Aphelios. Standard board is AD + upgraded frontline. Take the spatula off carousel for Lunar if possible.
Hold copies of Solar on your bench. If you upgrade them, play the Solar units as frontline. Kayle is quite weak so don't carry unless necessary.
Level to 8 and look for any frontline that can stall for Eclipse. Lillia 2 is the easiest to hit, but you can also tank Amumu, Sentinel, etc.

comps.name: Alistar Yunara Reroll
comps.augmentsTip: Play when you have lots of copies of Yunara with Blackthorn emblem. Prioritize Yunara > Tank > Warwick items. Murkwolf can also hold items temporarily until you get Yunara online.

tips.tip: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Alistar.
Level at 3-2 and roll for 2* upgrades then econ up. Skip Azir 2 because he's too expensive. Buy a charm every round if possible and win streak.
Finish your 3* units then push levels. Look for 3 Executioner for Yunara. Kennen caps your board. Blackthorn Lux is a high roll top end finisher.

comps.name: Flora Fatalis Sprykin Veigar Reroll

tips.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish your 3*, push levels for more Spyrkin, Blackthorn, or Brawlers.

comps.name: Sprykin Fae Rengar

tips.tip: Play for win streak with Rengar and the emblem. Position him same side as enemy carries to get backline snipes.
Keep snowballing with Rengar. Take an item augment if you aren't on track to get 3 items by end of Stage. Rengar only performs as well as your best tank so prioritize frontline too.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Rengar and 3* Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Tristana takes leftover items.

bm.name: Tristana Rengar Reroll

plan.overview: This comp should be played with an Emblem and ideally an early Rengar. If you have no special condition for this comp consider pivoting to something else. This is usually something you commit to on 2-1 around an emblem or Rengar orb. Rengar is the best holder of Sprykin, Hunter and Fae emblem.
plan.stage2: Play your strongest board around ideally a Rengar. The more you can scale up Rengar the easier it will be to scale into a game winning stat ball. Don't be afraid to click something like Urf if you are able to immediately make a Fae or Sprykin +1.
plan.stage3: Continue to be strong. If you are playing this from loss streak level to 7 on 3-5 and look for Tristana, Rengar and a supporting board based on your emblems. If you are pivoting in this late make sure you are uncontested.
plan.stage4: Slow roll for 3 star Rengar, Tristana and a front liner. Roll aggressively for wisps that can accelerate your econ or offer tailored shops. Finding a Lilia is a very easy way to be stable on this stage so be willing to dig.
plan.stage5: Level after hitting your 3 stars. Add Trait levels you are missing depending on your emblem.

tips: Sprykin Rider your Rengar if you have Sprykin emblem.
Your emblem decides the version of the comp you play. They can all cap very high and net a top 2 if you reach the required 3 stars.

comps.name: Fae Tristana Reroll

tips.tip: Play for win streak with upgraded Rageblade holder. Start stacking Fae since getting to 7 ASAP is crucial for success.
Itemize and play Tristana as soon as you find her. Sprykin is more important than Hunter. If you spike very early Primal from ahead, you can consider items.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Tristana and Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Give Sivir leftover AD items.

Keep adding more frontline. Rengar and Khazix will only be effective as your best tank. Item augments are huge to keep your momentum.

How to find and decide on an Opener
The highest priority when choosing an opener is solid direction. Choosing a solid game plan early and committing to it confidently. If you see a strong reroll augment, don't be afraid to commit. If you see an artifact that boosts a comp up a tier, be willing to commit and play a simple but efficient game of TFT.
Items
Shojin's the best item in the game due to it's flexibility. It has a lot of great holders for AD and AP at every point in the game. Gargoyle's and Warmog's are the 2 best tank items and will make win streaking easy. Any tank in the game is happy to have either of these items. Heavy damage items such as Deathblade and Rabadon's are great and stat sticks making them great damage options in every comp. Sterak's follows a similar theme to Deathblade and Rabadon's in the fact that it provides a lot of stats and is held very efficiently by Akali and Camilee who are the best 1 cost holds at the moment. Utility items are high up due to being necessary. Shred is higher up than Sunder due to most AD comps opting into Kog'Maw who provides these debuffs.
Sword, Rod and Belt are the highest priority components at the moment because they make they all make high quality items. There are not a lot of bad items at the moment so don't be afraid to slam aggressively. The current meta rewards those who save HP and have options during mid and late game.
Win Streak
Win streaking or at a minimum saving HP is very likely if you take a 2-1 item augment. Doing this puts you in the most flexible spot allowing you to consider reroll, fast 8 or even fast 9 if you win enough fights. Items give a lot of direction at the moment while allowing you to win streak so they're the best default option.
If you have a special condition play into that.
A wider pool of tempo lines that lead to top 4.
Most level 8 lines can top 4 and get to level 9 even if you are forced to roll on 8 for a while.
When you are playing for a win streak considering the item you will be left with after you slam is key to having higher quality items. Your item options will be limited and you are unlikely to get a sword, rod or belt which are the highest priority components. Think ahead of ways to kill bad components. You want to find ways to continue slamming decent items to potentially extend your win streak by playing around the premium components.
Ex: Making Kraken in a sword, bow, cloak opener as opposed to Giant Slayer . As having an open sword in this case is more likely to lead to a good completed item on carousel even if Giant Slayer is a slightly better item.
You are likely not going to get your desired items so build items that fulfill similar roles.
Ex: Deathblade instead of Kraken even if you might prefer Kraken as they both fulfill the role of providing AD.
